notes: Snapshot FY2024 (year ended Mar 31, 2024). The BRSR is the SEBI-mandated Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report, released by Biocon as a Supplementary Data Book with the Integrated Annual Report FY2024 (tier filing); its boundary is Biocon Limited plus Biocon Biologics (India and Malaysia) and excludes Syngene. It gives only national vs international counts, so international plants/offices are a region row (the plants are named as Malaysia and New Jersey, offices are not). The BRSR says Biocon serves 120+ countries but gives no per-country counts; its workforce table is by nationality, not location, so it is not used. No employees or taxes by country found. Sites come from the Integrated Annual Report's own descriptions; Syngene's sites (Bengaluru, Mangaluru, Hyderabad) are not listed.
